typed_benefit_semantics_and_provenance.notes: Typed limit/evidence primitives and fail-closed manual-review semantics passed CI. Production semantics remain subject to further plan-format and edge-case expansion.

authorization_privacy_security_primitive.notes: Alpha 0.4 verifies irreversible per-proposal decisions, explicit authorization/disclosure categories, no raw proposal identifier persistence, demo input bounds, and sanitized audit behavior. Production IAM, secret-store, retention, jurisdiction/legal-role, and multi-user controls remain incomplete.

provider_direct_billing_evidence_model.notes: Assertion-level provenance/freshness is demonstrated with synthetic sources only. No live directory, insurer, or regulator automation is authorized.

transaction_state_machine.notes: Verified local simulator demonstrates stable transaction/operation/attempt identities, idempotency, confirmation semantics, waitlist/rejection, retry-safe failure, reconciliation-required ambiguity, and calendar projection only after confirmation. It is not a live adapter.
